title: Annual Leave Entitlement
policy_text: All full-time employees are eligible for 24 annual leave days per calendar year. Leave is accrued monthly at a rate of 2 days per month and must be approved by the employee's direct manager at least 3 working days in advance.

title: Carry Forward of Unused Leave
policy_text: Employees may carry forward a maximum of 5 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year. Any leave beyond this limit will be forfeited unless prior written approval is obtained from HR Admin.

title: Sick Leave Entitlement
policy_text: Employees are entitled to 12 paid sick leave days per calendar year. A medical certificate is required for sick leave exceeding 2 consecutive days.

title: Extended Medical Leave
policy_text: Employees requiring medical leave beyond 12 days must apply for Extended Medical Leave, which is unpaid unless covered by accumulated leave balances or company insurance.

title: Maternity Leave Policy
policy_text: Female employees are entitled to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave, starting up to 8 weeks before the expected delivery date. A minimum of 6 months of continuous service is required.

title: Paternity Leave Policy
policy_text: Male employees are entitled to 10 working days of paid paternity leave, to be taken within 3 months of the child's birth.

title: Work From Home Eligibility
policy_text: Employees may work from home up to 2 days per week, subject to manager approval. Roles requiring physical presence (e.g., front desk, lab staff) are excluded.

title: Remote Work Equipment Policy
policy_text: Employees approved for regular work from home may request a laptop and monitor from the IT department. Equipment remains company property and must be returned upon resignation or termination.

title: Standard Working Hours
policy_text: Standard working hours are 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday to Friday, with a 1-hour lunch break. Employees are expected to log attendance via the company portal daily.

title: Late Arrival Policy
policy_text: Employees arriving more than 15 minutes late on 3 or more occasions in a month will receive a formal attendance notice from their manager.

title: Overtime Eligibility and Pay
policy_text: Non-managerial employees who work beyond standard hours with prior manager approval are eligible for overtime pay at 1.5x the regular hourly rate.

title: Payroll Cycle
policy_text: Salaries are processed on a monthly basis and credited to employee bank accounts by the last working day of each month.

title: Accessing Salary Slips
policy_text: Salary slips are available for download from the employee self-service portal under 'Payroll > Salary Slips' by the 2nd working day of each month.

title: Probation Period Policy
policy_text: All new employees undergo a probation period of 6 months from their date of joining, during which either party may terminate employment with 2 weeks' notice.

title: Resignation Notice Period
policy_text: Confirmed employees must serve a notice period of 60 days upon resignation. Employees on probation must serve 14 days' notice.

title: Health Insurance Coverage
policy_text: All full-time employees are covered under group health insurance from their date of joining, covering the employee, spouse, and up to 2 dependent children.

title: Retirement Savings Plan
policy_text: Employees are automatically enrolled in the company retirement savings plan after 1 year of continuous service, with the company matching contributions up to 5% of base salary.

title: Travel Reimbursement Policy
policy_text: Employees traveling for official work purposes may claim reimbursement for travel, accommodation, and meals with valid receipts, submitted within 30 days of travel.

title: Internet and Phone Reimbursement
policy_text: Employees working from home regularly may claim up to a fixed monthly amount for internet and phone expenses, submitted quarterly with valid bills.

title: Performance Review Cycle
policy_text: Formal performance reviews are conducted twice a year, in April and October. Reviews assess goal achievement, competencies, and are used for compensation decisions.

title: How to Contact HR
policy_text: For any queries not covered by this handbook, employees may contact the HR helpdesk via email at hr-support@company.com or visit the HR office between 10 AM and 5 PM on working days.
